text_block_list.text:
This may be small comfort, but I know
that you
tried your best.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The opportunity to broaden my
knowledge of the
world has been reward
enough.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And besides, these claw machines seem
more
difficult than I anticipated. Many
have surely
experienced the same
frustration.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's a shame so few will get their hands
on these
plushies. I would love to see
them spread
throughout the world...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
